label: Install Play Release APK on Device (adb install)
command: export PATH="/home/inan/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$PATH" && APK=$(find /home/inan/.gradle-builds/Rivo4/app/outputs/apk/play/release -maxdepth 1 -name "*.apk" | head -n 1) && [ -n "$APK" ] && adb install -r -d -g "$APK" || (echo 'Release APK not found! Build it first.' && exit 1)
